name: Bullpane
tagline: The self-hosted BullMQ dashboard you can put in front of production.
description: Queues, jobs, failures and Redis health across multiple connections, in one place — without your data leaving your network. Job search and bulk actions (retry, remove, promote), logs and stack traces per job, BullMQ Pro groups, schedulers and metrics. MIT core; Pro adds alerts, roles and audit log.

name: bullmq-fanout
tagline: Turn BullMQ into a message bus.
description: Publish one domain event to many queues, each with its own worker, retries and failure domain. Works with BullMQ v5, v6 and Pro.
